_comment: Run engine/calibration.py to regenerate eta/cd/frontal_area_m2. These are its actual output, not hand-picked values.
_calibration_changelog: Why: the previous values were never produced by a working fit. calibration.py scored candidates on trip TIME, but time in physics.py depends only on cruise speed and wind, not on eta/cd/frontal_area - so every grid point tied and the search returned whichever was enumerated first. Rebuilt to fit on energy anchors (hover endurance -> eta; cruise Wh/km at peak speed -> cd*frontal_area), with an identifiability assertion that fails loudly if the score ever goes flat in its parameters again.
Fit quality: hover endurance 12.1 min vs 12.0 target; 27.7 Wh/km vs 28.0 target; residual 0.023. The Zomato 5kg/5km reference flight is feasible at 76% of usable capacity.
Note: cd and frontal_area_m2 are not separately identifiable - only their product (0.10) is. cd is pinned at the conventional 1.0 to break the tie.

wind._comment: 315 = wind from NW, a common prevailing direction; treat as a static field for this simulation
